_readme: Orientation anchors for the map. Every entry carries its own source and a
`confirmed` flag; anything with confirmed=false renders with a '?' and is listed
in the map's 'needs confirmation' block rather than being quietly published.
anchor=true  -> stays on screen in every frame of the reveal sequence, so viewers
never lose their bearings when the map zooms into a phase.
county address point   Bay County Basic_Layers/MapServer/0 - public record
site plan              read visually off the builder's published site plan
aerial                 position read off public aerial imagery

landmarks.name: Town Square Amenity
note: One point, two stories. Karen confirmed the Bandshell as the Town Center
anchor, and it is also the origin of the live-music noise. So the
'how far to the Town Center' distance and the 'can I hear the band' ring
share a centre: the closer you are, the more you get and the more you hear.
The amenity core is built around it — Fins Up! Fitness immediately north,
Latitude Bar and Chill plus Paradise Pool immediately south, the
amphitheater and Bandshell west of the main parking. It is the middle of
the complex, not its edge.
RETIRED CANDIDATE: 8520 Latitude Blvd (30.312154, -85.863968) is a mailing
address reference only. It sits 554 m / 0.34 mi NNE of the Bandshell and is
not the point a buyer would walk to. Do not use it as the Town Center.

landmarks.name: Paradise Pool
landmarks.source: Karen — "that is the correct location for the pool"

landmarks.name: Barkaritaville Dog Park
landmarks.source: KAREN — she marked the site on an aerial; centre re-measured as the clearing's centroid
note: Two independent sources landed 6 m apart, which is why this is now
confirmed. The original pin came off the builder's site plan through the
solved georeference. Karen then marked the site on an aerial, and the
same scene appears in the aerial she sent of the marina — a shot already
fitted to my own plat geometry and checked by overlay. Measuring the
clearing in that fitted shot gives this coordinate.
The match is not a near-miss: both show the same junction and building
block, the same parking bay off Latitude Blvd, the same path curving
south, the same pavilion in the clearing, and the same pond with a
hooked sandy shore. The clearing measures about 0.9 acres.
Karen's words were 'dog park coming', so it is built but not yet open.
Say 'coming' on screen, not 'open'.

landmarks.name: Stay & Play Cottages
landmarks.source: centroid of the recorded cottage homesites inside the Town Center plat (PB 32/81)
note: Marketed as the Getaway Cottages. These are the only homesites in the
plat recorded as 'PH 5A3' - everything else in it is the amenity tract,
which is why there is no Phase 5A neighbourhood.
KAREN: the block the builder's plan still marks 'Future Development',
immediately west of these, is also Stay & Play. That expansion is not in
the public record, so it is drawn as an unconfirmed marker only.

landmarks.name: Future marina
landmarks.source: KAREN — she ringed the site on an aerial and refers to it as the future location of the marina
note: LANGUAGE, KAREN'S: call this 'the future location of the marina'. Do not
say 'under construction' on screen or in the script, even though site
work is plainly under way — the marina itself is not being built yet.
Land-use permits are secured, water permits are pending.
It is NOT on the builder's June 2026 site plan. Karen's words were that
it 'is not on their maps yet, that is just the area they are building'.
So no footprint is drawn and no basin shape is implied; the marker marks
roughly where, and nothing more.
The coordinate is the centroid of the graded pad inside the ring Karen
drew — about 14 acres already cleared — measured on an aerial fitted to
my own pond and plat geometry and checked by overlay. That is the part
actually being worked, so it is more defensible than the centre of her
ring, which also takes in water and trees.
SUPERSEDED, DO NOT REINTRODUCE: the pin used to sit 151 m east of here,
derived as the pole of inaccessibility of the open land between the
Phase 4 plats, the Town Center tract and the bay. That put it in the
trees at the edge of the site rather than on the works.

landmarks.name: Port of Indecision Kayak Launch
landmarks.source: KAREN — she drew an arrow at it on an aerial; this is the arrow tip
note: The arrow points at the small pale launch structure on the west bank of
the creek, just downstream of the Town Square. That aerial was fitted
using Google's own Fins Up! and Paradise Pool markers, and checked
against the Bandshell, which was not used in the solve and landed on the
amphitheater.
This moved the pin about 35 m from the site-plan reading, which had it
up on the bank rather than at the water.

landmarks.name: Pickleball & Tennis
landmarks.source: area-weighted centroid of the three court banks, which are machine-fitted from georeferenced aerial imagery — see town_center_courts.json
note: Karen asked for these by name. The courts are the one Town Center surface
that did not have to be read by eye: court paint samples b-r = +65 against
+18 to +28 for every roof and every stretch of asphalt, so it thresholds
cleanly and each bank is fitted with a minimum-area rectangle.
The largest bank measures 77.4 x 41.2 m and holds four courts at 19.3 m per
bay, against 18.3 m for a tennis court with its run-off. That is a genuine
check on the scale as well as the shape.
ONE LABEL FOR THREE BANKS, DELIBERATELY — but no longer because the
identification was in doubt. Minto's published amenity plan labels the
western bank 'Tennis' and the eastern group 'Pickleball', with the
Community Services Building between them, and that split matches the
measured geometry: a 38 m gap after the tennis bank, then the two
pickleball banks 5 m apart. Each bank is named individually in
town_center_courts.json.
The map still carries one combined label because at community scale the
two centroids are 115 m apart — millimetres on the sheet — so two labels
would collide and read worse than one true one.
The single court south-west of these is drawn separately and is the
Multi-Purpose Court, confirmed by Karen.
